statement: CallCellInvoker dispatches independent partition-local run executions through a named bounded concurrency owner whose maxConcurrentShardRuns limit derives from system policy, preserving deterministic slot and wire identity, the shared invocation deadline, fail-closed complete-result semantics with deterministic stable-slot-order failure selection, and exactly-once-visible reduction, with invocation-level telemetry, proven by multi-node evidence that at least two run executions overlap in time, concurrency never exceeds the configured limit, one shard failure prevents reduction and final publication, and serial and parallel dispatch return identical results for the same invocation.
